neighbours.label: Gu-initial place names, tested on Guatemala, Guadalajara, Guangxi, Guizhou, Guanajuato, Guayaquil, Guinea, and Guadeloupe.
fire: A photographer returned from Guatemala with a notebook full of sketches.
The conference organizers booked a small venue in Guadalajara.
Our atlas includes a detailed map of Guangxi beside the regional overview.
A long railway journey took the visitors through Guizhou.
The travel diary describes a quiet afternoon in Guanajuato.
Their itinerary includes an overnight stop in Guayaquil.
The classroom wall map marks Guinea with a small colored pin.
A sailing magazine printed a feature about the coastline of Guadeloupe.
quiet: After visiting Honduras, a photographer filled a notebook with sketches.
A small venue in Monterrey was booked for the conference.
Beside its regional overview, our atlas provides a detailed map of Yunnan.
The visitors crossed Sichuan during a long journey by rail.
A quiet afternoon in Oaxaca is described in the travel diary.
An overnight visit to Quito appears on their travel itinerary.
A small colored pin on the classroom map marks Senegal.
The coastline of Martinique was featured in a sailing magazine.

notes: The shared spelling pattern is tested across geographically unrelated places, including Guayaquil, Guinea and Guadeloupe beyond the inspected top examples. Probes on several Gu names fired while Granada and Barcelona did not; a bare Gu mention was weaker. Ottoman and other geographic contexts also appear on the card, so this bounded word-family hypothesis is not presented as full coverage.
